title_zh: 先练足球盯人和补位而不只盯比分

scenario.label_zh: 针对失球原因调整足球防守练习
scenario.goal_zh: 复盘失球原因并约定先练习盯人和补位

context_zh: 一支虚构英国业余足球队复盘上场比赛并调整训练。
author: author-phase07-b

sentences.speaker: Callum
sentences.text: Was Saturday's defeat mainly my fault? Their striker got past me twice.

sentences.speaker: Coach Evans
sentences.text: You were the nearest defender, but you had no cover. We need to look at the whole defence.

sentences.speaker: Callum
sentences.text: I kept following the ball and lost track of the runner behind me.

sentences.speaker: Coach Evans
sentences.text: Then let's practise how to defend that space. One player closes down the ball while another watches the runner.

sentences.speaker: Callum
sentences.text: Can we try it slowly first? I want to know when to call for help.

sentences.speaker: Coach Evans
sentences.text: Yes. We'll walk through the movement before adding speed.

sentences.speaker: Callum
sentences.text: Good. I'd rather fix that than spend the session arguing about the score.

targets.sense_zh: 球队的防守整体或防守力量，英式拼写
防守；保护球场上的区域
